thag11.1:1.1: Dasanipāto niṭṭhito. EKĀDASANIPĀTO. Kin tav' attho vane tāta Ujjuhāno va pāvuse. verambā ramaṇīyā te, paviveko hi jhāyinaṃ. || ||
thag11.1:2.1: yathā abbhāni verambo vāto nudati pāvuse, saññā me abhikīranti vivekapaṭisaññutā. || ||
thag11.1:3.1: apaṇḍaro aṇḍasambhavo sīvathikāya niketacāriko uppādayateva me satiṃ sandehasmi virāganissitaṃ. || ||
thag11.1:4.1: yañ ca aññe na rakkhanti yo ca aññe na rakkhati, sa ve bhikkhu sukhaṃ seti kāmesu anapekkhavā. || ||
thag11.1:5.1: acchodikā puthusilā gonaṅgulamigāyutā ambusevālasañchannā te selā ramayanti maṃ. || ||
thag11.1:6.1: vasitam me araññesu kandarāsu guhāsu ca senāsanesu pantesu vāḷamiganisevite. || ||
thag11.1:7.1: ime haññantu vajjhantu dukkhaṃ pappontu pāṇino saṃkappaṃ nābhijānāmi anariyaṃ dosasaṃhitaṃ. || ||
thag11.1:8.1: pariciṇṇo mayā satthā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ, ohito garuko bhāro, bhavanetti samūhatā. || ||
thag11.1:9.1: yassa c' atthāya pabbajito agārasmā anagāriyaṃ, so me attho anuppatto sabbasaṃyojanakkhayo. || ||
thag11.1:10.1: nābhinandāmi maraṇam nābhinandāmi jīvitaṃ kālañ ca paṭikaṅkhāmi nibbisaṃ bhatako yathā. || ||
thag11.1:11.1: nābhinandāmi maraṇaṃ nābhinandāmi jīvitaṃ kālañ ca paṭikaṅkhāmi sampajāno patissato 'ti. || || Saṃkiccathero. uddānaṃ: Saṃkiccathero eko
thag11.1:12.0: va katakicco anāsavo Ekādasanipātamhi, gāthā ekādas' eva tā 'ti.
